answer: Re-attestations are stored in mesa and ledge lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the pigment graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 786 impostors cost 1384 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
